what: Recordings of a public post whose body carries a level-3 heading, a strong run, an em run and a link (the closed grammar of backend/src/public/markdown.js), of a post with city null, and of a coach with city / headline null. Without them pulse-fixture-check refuses the post-detail-3 specimen fixture (kept in pkg/S-public-pages/unrecorded-post-detail-3.json) and the 'no city' variants of post-tag-only / coach-minimal.
how: Seed (or publish on a sandbox coach) one post written with '### heading', '**bold**', '*italic*' and a [link](https://example.org), one post and one coach profile with no city, then record GET /public/posts/:id and /public/coaches/:handle with --record --only-missing. This package makes no live writes (PLAN 4.7).
interim: post-detail-3 is captured from a scratch frames file with the refused fixture (.pulse/pairs/S-public-pages/specimen) and reported as structure; post-tag-only and coach-minimal keep the city.
then: Move the override back into states.json and re-capture.
